help.subtitle: Answers to the questions we get the most. If you can't find yours, support is here.
help.stillStuckText: The team answers requests within [RESPONSE TIME] business days.

faq.a: SkillBridge is a skill-exchange platform for high-school students. You teach what you know, you earn credits, and you spend those credits to learn from other members. No real money is ever exchanged.

1 credit = 1 minute of teaching. You get 120 credits when you sign up. When you book a session the credits are set aside; at the end the teacher receives the credits actually spent and the difference is refunded to you. Balances are capped at 500 credits to encourage exchanges.

faq.q: Is there a minimum age to sign up?
faq.a: SkillBridge is aimed at high-school students aged 15 to 18. Below 15, French law requires the authorisation of a parent or guardian to process personal data. The exact conditions are set out in the terms of service.

faq.q: How do I find someone to exchange with?
faq.a: Go to Connections: you will see suggestions based on the skills you are looking for and the ones you offer. Send a connection request, then chat in the messaging area before scheduling a session.

You create a session from the Sessions tab. The other person accepts it, then you both meet in the session room at the agreed time. The timer counts the time actually spent, and credits are transferred at the end.

faq.q: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.a: From the login screen, click "Forgot your password?" and enter your email address. You will get a reset link valid for a few minutes. Remember to check your spam folder.

faq.q: Someone is behaving badly, how do I report it?
faq.a: Use the report form, available from the footer and from this page. Describe the situation precisely: every report is reviewed by the moderation team. If someone is in immediate danger, call 3018 (online violence) or 17 in France.

faq.q: How do I delete my account or get my data back?
faq.a: Go to Settings, "My account" section. Automatic export and deletion are coming soon; in the meantime support handles these requests manually, within the deadlines set by the GDPR.
Yes. Signing up and using the platform are free, and credits cannot be bought: they are earned by teaching. We never ask for a payment method.
